title: Quality Engineer - Schwerpunkt Testautomatisierung (all genders)
description:

Du hast Erfahrung im Testen von Hardware und Software? Testautomatisierung sowie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Testmethoden und -prozessen begeistern dich? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

title: Chief Information Officer
description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.
Job Description
As Chief Information Officer (CIO), you’ll lead the technology our teams rely on every day. That includes the systems employees use, the enterprise applications that run our go-to-market and financial operations, our data platform, our corporate website, and our cloud infrastructure.

You’ll lead through strong domain owners, and you’ll stay close enough to the technology to set standards, weigh plans, and ask the hard questions. You’ll work alongside our product general managers, product AI organization, security team, and Finance. What you’ll do
Set direction and own the enterprise systems estate

• Set priorities for internal technology against company plans, and hold each domain accountable for delivery.

• Own our enterprise applications, from CRM and marketing automation through ERP and financials, including the quote-to-cash flow between them.

• Guide enterprise and data architecture, and lead the integration and data engineers who build it.

• Run one intake, change-control, and planning cadence so a change in one system doesn’t break another.

Lead operations, data, and IT

• Lead Enterprise Systems and Revenue Operations, aligning systems ownership with operating responsibility for the go-to-market stack.

• Lead Cloud Operations across corporate and production environments (AWS and Azure), including availability, performance, cost, and security posture.

• Lead IT and end-user services: service desk, endpoints, identity and access, Microsoft 365, and Workday administration.

• Own our Snowflake data platform and integrations, with access governance set jointly with Finance.

• Own the corporate website, including development, vendor relationships, and change control.

Manage risk, spend, and AI

• Partner with our security team: you’re accountable for posture and execution, and they set standards and audit.

• Govern internal process automation and AI agents, including approval gates and production-readiness review, in coordination with the product AI organization.

• Own the technology budget and major vendor relationships, including planning, negotiation, and ROI.

• Build and retain a high-performing team with a clear owner for every domain.

What you bring

Required

• 15+ years in technology leadership, with growing responsibility for teams, programs, and budgets.

• 8+ years directing technical leaders across multiple disciplines.

• Deep expertise in enterprise and ERP architecture, data modeling, integration, and data engineering.

• Experience across enterprise applications and cloud infrastructure, leading through domain owners.

• Experience leading large-scale technology transformation and consolidation.

• Working knowledge of HIPAA and SOC 2 in a regulated, data-sensitive environment.

• A technical foundation, ideally including early-career engineering experience.

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

• SaaS or healthcare experience.

• Hands-on credibility with modern data platforms such as Snowflake.

• Contract negotiation experience that protects scope and delivers value.

How you work

• You explain technology in business terms. You build trust with product, finance, legal, and executive partners.

title: Learning Program Manager
description:
Summary:
This role supports the operational delivery and governance of learning and reskilling journeys across Hong Kong and other AME markets.
As learning pathways and workforce development programs continue to expand, there is a need for a dedicated Program Operations & Journey Operations Specialist to manage program tracking, reporting, governance activities and learner journey coordination.
The role will be responsible for ensuring participants progress successfully through learning journeys, maintaining operational oversight across multiple programs, identifying risks and dependencies, and providing timely reporting and insights to stakeholders. Working closely with learning leaders, program teams and business stakeholders, the successful candidate will help ensure programs are delivered efficiently and achieve intended outcomes.
Reporting to: Senior Learning Leader or Program Sponsor within the Learning Function.
Contract Details:

• Full-Time, 6‑month contract, Open to renewal
Success Measures:

• Timely and accurate program reporting.

• Effective management of program governance activities.

• Accurate tracking of learner participation, completion and outcomes.

• Positive stakeholder feedback regarding program operations support.

• Effective identification and management of risks, dependencies and operational issues.

• Successful coordination of job tasting, certification and learner journey activities.

Roles and Responsibilities:

• Program Operations & Governance:

• Own operational tracking and reporting across learning and reskilling journeys.

• Maintain program governance processes and meetings, including action, decision, dependency, and risk tracking.

• Maintain program documentation, trackers and operational records.

• Track participation, completion and program outcome metrics.

• Journey Operations & Coordination:

• Support the day-to-day operational management of learning and reskilling journeys.

• Coordinate learner journey activities and milestones across multiple program.

• Support the organization and coordination of job tasting activities and related logistics.

• Quality, Outcomes & Continuous Improvement:

• Capture and monitor learner and stakeholder feedback.

• Track key performance indicators, quality measures and program outcomes.

• Track certification and program completion requirements.

• Monitor learner completion status and follow up on outstanding actions.

• Support participants in resolving access, approval or process-related issues impacting completion.

• Maintain appropriate records and evidence relating to program participation and completion.

Essential Requirements

• Experience supporting program operations, learning operations, PMO or project coordination activities.

• Strong reporting and analytical skills with the ability to interpret and communicate program data.

• Strong organizational and coordination skills.

• Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

• Experience working with multiple stakeholder groups in a complex environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

•
Strong attention to detail and ability to proactively identify and resolve issues.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience supporting learning, talent, workforce transformation or reskilling programs.

• Experience within financial services or other regulated industries.

• Experience supporting regional or global programs.

请将完整的个人 PDF 版本简历发送至：jenna.wang@davionlabs.com
简历标题格式：姓名 - 【应聘Senior Blockchain Engineer】- 目前所在国家/城市

Davion Labs 现诚邀一位熟悉可信执行环境（TEE）与密码学，且具备扎实底层系统开发经验的高级区块链工程师（TEE方向）加入 ApeX Protocol核心团队。

title: Sr. People Operations Generalist
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Sr. People Generalist builds the operational backbone of the People team: the processes, systems, data, and policies that let us scale without adding complexity. This is a builder role, not an administrator role. You will turn work that runs on tribal knowledge and one-off fixes into documented, measured, repeatable programs with clear owners and controls.

You will be helping define the center of excellence model on the People team: the escalation point for employee matters, a data connoisseur that owns data fidelity , and the person who decides where work should live as the team matures from reactive support to a proactive shared-services model. You will lead cross-functional projects and use AI to shape the employee experience.

 

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

- Define the People Ops operating model: what is standardized and centralized, what stays with People Partners or other COEs, and how work transitions with continuity and measurement built in

- Assess the maturity of each core People process (onboarding, offboarding, job changes, comp cycles, leaves, time off, rotations) and run a roadmap to move each from ad hoc to documented, measured, and automated

- Be the operational partner to People Business Partners: execute reorgs, promotions, performance actions, and exits they drive; supply the data and process support behind their work

- Set standards for process design, documentation, SLAs, and handoffs; own the SOP library and knowledge base so answers live in a system

- Support the build of audit-ready controls (recurring data audits, approval trails, segregation of duties) for SOX

- Define service-quality metrics (ticket volume, resolution time, error rate, employee satisfaction) and use them to decide what to fix next

- Run proactive audits across Workday and connected systems to catch errors before they reach payroll, equity, or board reporting

- Serve as a functional Workday owner: business process design from requirements through configuration, testing, and post-launch iteration

- Use AI and low-code tools to prototype and ship People Ops automations; know when a gap needs a lightweight internal tool versus a technical build with IT or Systems

- Resolve the hardest cases in benefits, leaves, time off, rotations, and sensitive org changes with precision, empathy, and clear written communication

- Partner with Finance, Legal, IT, Recruiting, and Payroll on projects that mature processes and policies for the business

- Lead change management for process redesigns and new tools: communication, training, adoption tracking, and feedback

title: Staff Security Analyst (Governance and Trust)
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role in a nutshell:

Chainguard is building the secure foundation for software development and deployment. Our Governance & Trust team makes sure the security practices behind that mission are effective, measurable, and worthy of our customers' trust.

We're hiring a senior practitioner to lead the compliance and trust side of that team. You'll run the execution of our external examinations (SOC 2, ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials, and a growing set of sector and regional certifications), own how we respond to customer security diligence, and run third-party risk operations. You'll lead the compliance and trust side of the team, which includes a public-sector compliance analyst and two customer-facing security analysts, with formal management of that group expected as the team grows.

This is not a checklist compliance role. Our operating model treats policies and controls as code, draws evidence from systems of record rather than screenshots, and uses AI agents for first-pass questionnaire responses and vendor triage. You'll be the person who decides what those systems need to produce, judges whether what they produce is right, and stands behind it with an auditor or a customer.

What you’ll do:

• Run the execution of Chainguard's external examinations end to end: the evidence calendar, population and completeness-and-accuracy requests, sample fulfilment, auditor status calls, and readiness assessment ahead of each cycle. Work with the Head of Governance & Trust on scope, control applicability, and auditor negotiation.

• Build and keep the working relationships with People, IT, Infrastructure, Engineering, Legal, and Sales that evidence, populations, and remediation depend on. Compliance and trust at Chainguard runs across most of the company, and the function should not be chasing other teams for what it needs.

• Own customer security diligence: security questionnaires, customer audits, Trust Center content, and the multi-round assessments that regulated customers run. Set turnaround expectations with Sales that the team can meet, and decide what we will and won't provide.

• Own the third-party risk management program: vendor intake and tiering, assessments, dispositions, and the register of critical suppliers and their agreements.

• Act as product owner for the customer-facing side of our agent platform: define what the questionnaire responder and vendor triage agents must do, maintain the validated answer bank they draw on, and judge whether their output is good enough to send. Stay current on how other companies handle diligence and response automation, and bring in better approaches when they exist.

• Turn recurring patterns across questionnaires, audits, and vendor reviews into standing artifacts, self-serve packages, and control improvements, so the same question is answered once.

• Work from a single unified controls catalog across frameworks, and push mapping and implementation defects back to the governance side rather than maintaining framework-specific lists.

• Produce findings and remediation evidence that survive external re-test, and feed the corrective-action process with root causes rather than symptoms.

• Guide the public-sector compliance analyst's work on assessor relationships and customer-facing federal diligence, with technical scoping decisions staying with the Head of Gove

title: Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

- You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

As the Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer, you will own the development of high-speed control and protection systems for the Alpha fusion demonstrator, focusing on FPGA-based solutions for plasma heating hardware protection.

You will work across the full development lifecycle, from writing and verifying HDL code to developing software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, integrating embedded software and electronics, and establishing robust development and deployment pipelines.

You will also help establish Proxima’s FPGA development capability beyond plasma heating, defining reusable architectures, development workflows, testing methodologies, and HDL best practices that can be adopted across other systems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Design, implement, and maintain HDL-based control and protection systems, starting with plasma heating system protection.

- Establish end-to-end FPGA development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and SIL/HIL test environments integrated with plant design frameworks.

- Develop embedded software, firmware, and low-level drivers to interface FPGAs with sensors, actuators, and other control systems.

- Collaborate across RF, controls, electronics, and systems teams to define system interfaces, ICDs, and verification plans.

WHO YOU ARE

- Degree in Electronics, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

- Strong proficiency in HDL (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog) and software scripting (Python, C/C++).

- Proven experience integrating FPGAs with hardware peripherals, board-level electronics, and communication interfaces.

- Familiarity with modern software development practices (Git, CI, code review, automated testing).

- Systems-thinking approach with strong debugging skills spanning HDL, embedded firmware, and physical hardware.

Nice to have:

- High-speed digital interfaces (multi-gigabit serial links, LVDS, SerDes, RF/instrumentation links) and PCB-level signal integrity.

- FPGA+processor platforms and MPSoCs (e.g., AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+).

- Precision timing and synchronization (IEEE 1588 PTP, White Rabbit)

- Network protocols (Ethernet).

- Real-time signal processing, fast protection systems, and high-speed data acquisition in fusion or industrial environments.

- HDL design methodologies and techniques for reliable radiation-hardened systems.

- Schematic comprehension and custom PCB development.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

- Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

- Technical Screening (30 min)

- Technical Panel (3x60 min)

title: Co-Op, Bayesian Methods for Complex Decision Making
locationText: Cambridge, MA USA; San Francisco, CA USA
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences builds AI systems that accelerate discovery across the physical and life sciences. Within Physical Sciences AI, we work with experimental teams to build autonomous discovery agents that decide which experiments Lila's AI Science Factories should run next.

Real scientific campaigns rarely look like textbook optimization problems. A single campaign can mix large discrete choices (which components, which recipe) with continuous settings (amounts, temperatures, times), pursue several objectives under hard constraints, and draw on evidence from literature and characterization data. Every experiment costs real time and materials. Off-the-shelf methods often struggle here, and they ignore the domain structure that could guide the search.

As a Bayesian Methods Co-Op, you will work alongside research scientists and engineers on a focused project within one broad question: how AI systems can make better experimental decisions. Depending on your background, that could mean building agents that choose the next experiment, testing when in-context learners can be trusted as decision-makers, or developing Bayesian strategies for tight experimental budgets. Your methods will be tested against live campaigns.

What You'll Be Building

• Design and benchmark experiment-selection strategies that balance exploration and exploitation under realistic budgets

• Build autonomous discovery agents that propose the next experiment from surrogate models

• Develop in-context learning approaches inspired by Bayesian inference, evaluating calibration and robustness

• Run retrospective and live evaluations on active campaign data with clear baselines and metrics

• Present findings to ML and experimental teams, with the option to contribute to a publication

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Pursuing a Master's or PhD in statistics, ML, CS, operations research, applied math, or a quantitative science

• Solid grounding in Bayesian inference and decision making, including priors and posterior predictive distributions

• Research experience in Gaussian processes, Bayesian optimization, bandits, reinforcement learning, or probabilistic modeling

• Strong Python skills with PyTorch and probabilistic libraries such as Pyro, PyMC, or BoTorch

• Comfort working with small, noisy, and heterogeneous datasets

• Clear communication with both ML and experimental collaborators

Bonus Points For

• Applying these methods to real problems in materials science, chemistry, or another physical science

• Familiarity with in-context learning as implicit Bayesian inference, meta-learning, or prior-data fitted networks

• Optimization over categorical or combinatorial spaces, including mixed-variable, multi-objective, or batch settings

• Reinforcement learning for sequential decision making or Bayesian experimental design

• Training models on multimodal scientific data such as text, images, spectra, or simulations

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

description:

What you’ll be doing:

• Serve as the senior technical point of contact for OEM Federal deployments of NVIDIA GPU-accelerated platforms, including PCIe GPUs, HGX, and MGX systems, addressing any blocking issues.

• Own Issues End to End: Take responsibility for customer issues from start to finish - prioritizing platform, firmware, and workload problems. Drive these issues through the OEM's support tiers into NVIDIA engineering with the necessary logs and reproduction details to identify the root cause. Follow through with the customer until resolution.

• Failure Analysis & RMA: Establish and complete diagnostic, RMA eligibility, and replacement procedures for Federal deployments. This includes situations where failed hardware and logs must remain on-site at the customer facility.

• Navigate Federal security frameworks including FedRAMP, IL5/IL6, and air-gapped (SCIF) environments, and help the customer meet sanitization and chain-of-custody requirements for hardware returns.

• Partner with OEM Federal support and services teams to reduce blocking issues and unnecessary dispatches. Detail failure signatures to build the Federal knowledge base and apply AI tools where the environment allows.

What we need to see:

• Due to the classified nature of the work, the selected candidate must be a U.S. citizen and possess and maintain an active U.S. Government TS/SCI clearance. Certain Intelligence Community customer assignments may also require a current U.S. Government-administered Counterintelligence Scope or Full Scope Polygraph.

• BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of engineering experience on multi-GPU platforms, including at least 3 years in a customer-facing support, field engineering, or blocking issue role.

• Strong system software expertise across firmware, BIOS, kernel, drivers, and operating systems, with the ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and customize Linux environments for AI/ML workloads.

• Expert knowledge of data center infrastructure - x86/ARM systems, high-performance storage, and low-latency networking (InfiniBand/RDMA).

• Professional-level communication and organizational skills, including adjusting to the technical level of the audience, staying calm and focused in negative situations, and driving issues through to closure.

• This role requires up to 35% travel to customer, partner, and data center sites, including secure facilities, and occasional weekend and holiday coverage.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Dell Ecosystem Expertise: Proven experience with Dell PowerEdge GPU servers and Dell's management software (OpenManage, APEX), and familiarity with Dell's support and process for handling blocking issues.

• Federal Mission Experience: Direct experience supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, or Civilian agency deployments, and comfort operating within their security and logistics constraints.

title: VP, Data Engineering

description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere - and outsized ownership while you build - we'd love to meet you.

THE ROLE

Data at Confido feeds customer-facing reports, internal dashboards, and a lot of day-to-day decisions. Right now it lives in too many places and is owned by too many people. We’re hiring a VP of Data Engineering to own all of it: how data gets into our systems, how it’s stored and modeled, and how it shows up in the reports people use, inside the company and out.

You’ll be the single owner of data at Confido. You’ll manage our Senior Analytics Engineer to start, and you’ll build the team from there. Early on you’ll be hands-on. Over time, more of your time will go to hiring, setting direction, and working with the leadership team.

What You’ll Own

- Ingestion. Every source that feeds our data, including product databases, event tracking, and third-party tools. You decide how data comes in, how often, and what happens when a source changes or breaks.

- Warehouse and pipelines. Warehouse design, orchestration, and the infrastructure underneath, including its cost.

- Modeling. One set of core models and metric definitions that the whole company uses.

- Reporting. Internal dashboards and BI, plus the data behind customer-facing reports. If a number shows up somewhere at Confido, it’s yours.

- Quality and governance. Testing, monitoring, access controls, and data privacy. You’re accountable when numbers are wrong, and you put fixes in place so the same problems don’t come back.

What You’ll Do

- Work with Engineering, Product, Ops, and Customer teams to figure out what data they actually need, and say no when something isn’t worth building.

- Set the standards the team works by: modeling, testing, docs, monitoring, and on-call.

- Write SQL, review PRs, and build things yourself while the team is small.

What We’re Looking For

- 10+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or similar, with 4+ years leading data teams.

- You’ve owned data end to end before, from ingestion through reporting, not just one layer of it.

- You’ve built a data function from an early or messy state, grown the team, and kept it running.

- Strong SQL and data modeling skills, and experience with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or similar tools.

- You’ve hired well, including people senior to where the team started.

- You can sit in a leadership meeting, turn “we need better data” into a plan, and defend it.

- You’re comfortable being hands-on now and stepping back as the team grows.

Success in This Role

A year in, there’s no question about who owns data at Confido. People trust the numbers and know where to find them. Sources are documented, pipelines break less often, and when they do, the team catches it before a customer does. Internal and customer-facing reports run off the same definitions. The team has grown, it has a clear structure and standards, and it’s planned out for the next stage.

title: Lead Solution Marketing Manager, Cybersecurity Segments and Industries
description:

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

We are seeking a Lead Solutions Marketing Manager to support the development of industry- and segment-focused positioning, content, and sales enablement for the Lumen Security portfolio. The ideal candidate brings a passion for technology and storytelling, a customer-focused mindset, and the ability to simplify complex cybersecurity concepts into clear, compelling stories that connect Lumen capabilities to customer needs and business outcomes.
This role will translate customer, industry, and market insights into relevant solution narratives, messaging, content, and sales enablement tailored to priority industries, segments, and buyer audiences. The work will connect Lumen Security capabilities to customer challenges and business priorities, helping buyers understand how Lumen can address their cybersecurity needs.
The Lead Solutions Marketing Manager will work closely with Solutions Marketing, Product Marketing, Sales, Campaign Operations, Creative, Analyst Relations, and subject matter experts to develop differentiated, market-relevant content that supports broader go-to-market priorities.
This is a highly collaborative role for a self-motivated marketer who can independently manage projects, build strong cross-functional relationships, and turn market and customer insights into compelling stories and content.

Location

This is a fully remote position open to candidates based anywhere in the U.S. Occasional travel is expected for team meetings, customer engagements, sales events, and industry conferences.

The Main Responsibilities

• Develop expertise in priority industries and customer segments, including market trends, customer needs, pain points, buying priorities, and emerging opportunities.

• Translate complex cybersecurity and technology capabilities into clear, customer-focused messaging, value propositions, use cases, proof points, and differentiated stories.

• Develop industry- and segment-specific messaging, narratives, and content that connect Lumen solutions to relevant customer challenges and business outcomes.

• Create market-facing content such as solution briefs, eBooks, whitepapers, research reports, presentations, web content, and other assets that support go-to-market priorities.

• Develop sales enablement content that helps sellers understand customer challenges, industry and segment needs, relevant use cases, and the value of Lumen solutions.

• Adapt broader solution messaging and content for priority industries, customer segments, and buyer audiences.

• Partner across Solutions Marketing, Product Marketing, Sales, Demand Generation, and other subject matter experts to ensure messaging and content are accurate, relevant, and aligned with broader priorities.

• Incorporate customer, seller, market, and industry insights to continually strengthen messaging, content, and use cases.

What We Look For in a Candidate

• Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, cybersecurity, information technology, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.

• 5 years of experience in solutions marketing, segment marketing, industry marketing, product marketing, content marketing, or a related B2B te

Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us - and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

SNHU is a nonprofit university whose mission is to expand access to high-quality, affordable education. Protecting student records, financial aid systems, and the academic platforms our learners depend on is a direct contribution to that mission.

You will work 100% remotely from any of our approved states.

• Integrate Microsoft security telemetry with SNHU's SIEM, SOAR, IT service management, and threat intelligence platforms; troubleshoots cross-platform issues through to permanent resolution; and serves as the security engineering point of contact with Microsoft, assessing roadmap changes, feature releases, and deprecations for their impact on SNHU controls.

title: Chief Strategy Officer

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.
Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. • Utilize CMM measurement techniques and perform uncertainty analysis for dimensional integrity.

• Differentiate between actual part deviations and artefacts caused by fixturing or alignment issues.

• Deliver clear, comprehensive written and verbal feedback to support decision-making on FAI sign-off.

• Contribute nuanced, high-quality metrology input to inform and enhance AI system development.

• Proficiency with 3D scanning devices and inspection software (e.g., PolyWorks, GOM Inspect, or similar).

• Proven ability to interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, and technical specifications.

• Experience producing or approving FAI reports backed by practical metrology knowledge.

Every courier who works with Relay chooses their day. A day is a set of routes that have to fit together, and every courier's ideal day competes with everyone else's. Work is finite and every route still has to be covered, so matching thousands of couriers to the work they want is a recommendation problem with few precedents.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. There's no existing recommender to iterate on. You'll build it.

RECOMMENDER SYSTEMS HIGHLIGHTS

- Combinatorial, constrained and competitive: every recommendation has to be feasible for the whole network, not just right for one courier.

- Your models power large-scale optimisation that balances thousands of couriers' preferences against the constraints of a physical network.

- Price is part of the recommendation, so economics, personalisation and optimisation have to work as one.

- Our apps collect millions of data points every day.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Principal Machine Learning Scientist at Relay, you'll:

- Set the standard for recommender systems at Relay.

- Lead the evolution of Relay's recommender from research to production.

- Design and build the recommender systems that power Relay's key decisions.

- Partner with Operational Research to unite recommender models and optimisation.

- Contribute to Relay's research culture, and develop our voice in the tech community.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have built recommender systems at scale, owned them in production, and led their direction.

- Bring deep expertise in recommender systems, reinforcement learning and LLMs, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

- Think in experiments, and let evidence guide decisions.

- Are energised by open-ended problems, and know how to make them tractable.

- Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

Job Title: Electronics Technician

About 9 Mothers

The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"-we are building the shield.

Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge-on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack.

Why 9 Mothers?

While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month-not next year-this is your playground.

Position Summary

9 Mothers builds robotic weapons systems - including EDDA, a robotic shotgun turret for counter-UAS, and a proprietary belt-fed shotgun platform. Every prototype we field is an electromechanical system full of cable harnesses, wired compute and control boxes, and custom PCBAs. Today, that build work is done by mechanical engineers and engineering management. That stops with this hire.

This role owns hands-on electronics fabrication for the company: building cables and harnesses, wiring compute and control enclosures, and reworking PCBAs. Your workmanship goes directly into weapons systems that get run hard at the range, so it has to be right - clean, documented, and durable. Most of your time is in the Cable & Harness Fabrication (Core)

- Build cables and wire harnesses from schematics, harness drawings, or an engineer’s sketch - cut, strip, crimp, solder, pin, and pot as required

- Work across connector families common to robotic and vehicle systems: circular/mil-spec connectors, D-subs, Molex/JST/board-level connectors, RF/coax, and power connectors, using correct tooling for each

- Label, sleeve, and strain-relieve harnesses for hard use on outdoor, live-fire robotic platforms - vibration, heat, dust, and repeated teardown

- Verify every build: continuity, pinout, insulation resistance / hipot where appropriate; capture as-builts and redline drawings so the next build is faster

Box Builds & System Wiring

- Wire compute and control enclosures end-to-end: panel layout, component mounting, power distribution, wire routing and dressing, grounding and shielding

- Perform point-to-point checkout and initial power-up checks before handing boxes to engineering for bring-up

- Build repeatably - when we need the second and third unit, they should match the first

PCBA Rework & Repair

- Rework and repair PCBAs: component replacement (through-hole and SMT), ECO / blue-wire modifications, connector replacement, and conformal coating touch-up

- Troubleshoot boards and assemblies to the failed component using DMM, oscilloscope, and bench power supplies

Test Setups & Fixtures

- Build and run simple electrical test setups: cable life/flex testing, actuator test fixtures, breakout boxes, load banks, and long-duration soak tests

- Instrument tests, log results, and report failures with enough detail that engineering can act on them

- Maintain the electronics lab: test equipment, soldering stations, crimp tooling, and stock of wire, connectors, and consumables

Field Support

- Travel to test ranges when needed to repair harnesses, boxes, and electronics on deployed systems and support live-fire test events

- Work safely around firearms and an active belt-fed shotgun platform, with disciplined adherence to range safety protocols

Requirements

- 5+ years of hands-on experience as an electronics technician, electrical assembler, or similar role building and repairing complex electromechanical hardware - robotics, aerospace, defense, automotive, test equ

description: Mission: Live at the intersection of app runtime & security. Protect applications in a fundamental way so that developers can build great application services and not be constantly looking over their shoulder. BlueRock is changing the landscape of App runtime security. The role Location: Must be based in CA (preferably San Francisco Bay Area) or North Carolina You will work alongside BlueRock's product designers and the control plane development team on our operator consoles. These are the React front ends that engineers and security teams use to manage large fleets of protected nodes, see what AI agents are actually doing across those fleets, and author the policy that constrains them. The domain is AI and agentic systems, seen from the operations and security side. When an agent calls an MCP server, spawns a subagent, runs a shell command in a sandbox, or burns $40 of tokens in an afternoon, our UI is where a person sees it, understands it, and decides what to allow. So the interesting problems are visibility problems (how do you show a thousand agent sessions so someone can find the one that matters?) and control problems (how do you author an enforcement policy without a mistake taking production down?). This is a mid-level role. We expect about 3-5 years of professional front-end experience, or equivalent work that clearly shows the same judgment. The ideal candidate is passionate about user experience, design, and AI-assisted software development, with a demonstrated grounding in engineering best practices. The title says UI, but the work doesn’t stop there: you’ll work closely with our backend services, and a feature is finished when it’s proven working live, not when the screen looks right.

title: Telecom Designer (Buildings Engineering)
description:
Michael Baker International is seeking a Telecom Designer to join our growing team and contribute to the design of innovative low-voltage and telecommunications systems for a variety of complex and exciting projects, including high-profile Federal projects . This is a great opportunity to build your technical expertise while working alongside experienced engineers, architects, and designers in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment. Under the guidance of senior team members, you’ll apply engineering and design fundamentals, develop plans and construction documents, and help deliver integrated technology solutions that support our clients and their facilities.

In this role, you will:

• Assist in the design of low-voltage and telecommunications systems, equipment, components, and infrastructure for a variety of project types.

• Contribute to projects across a variety of markets, including Federal and government, higher education, healthcare, commercial, and other complex facilities .

• Develop construction specifications and drawings and support projects through construction, including field inspections, field acceptance testing, contractor coordination, and review of close-out documentation.

• Collaborate with engineers, architects, project managers, and other technical professionals across multiple offices and disciplines.

• Participate in occasional project-related travel and site visits.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

• Data/voice structured cabling systems

• Audiovisual presentation and conferencing systems

• Wireless systems, including Wi-Fi

• Data center infrastructure

• Access control

• Intrusion detection

• Video surveillance systems

• RCDD certification preferred.

• Experience with Autodesk Revit and/or AutoCAD and Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel.

• Familiarity with Building Information Modeling (BIM) preferred.

• Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with an understanding of how architectural and engineering disciplines work together throughout the design and construction process.

• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.

• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple assignments while meeting project deadlines.

title: Product Owner métier GMAO — Maximo / Transition vers MAS 9 (F/H)
description:
Description et livrables de la prestation
Contexte :
Un grand groupe du secteur des services à l’environnement recherche un Product Owner métier GMAO pour accompagner la transition de son environnement Maximo vers Maximo Application Suite 9 (MAS 9).
Le programme s’appuie sur des équipes disposant d’une bonne connaissance de Maximo et sur un partenaire chargé de la configuration. Le PO portera la vision et les besoins métier, en interface avec les utilisateurs, les équipes SI et ce partenaire.
Votre rôle :
Vous traduisez les enjeux opérationnels de maintenance en besoins fonctionnels clairs et priorisés. Vous challengez les demandes, contribuez aux arbitrages et veillez à ce que la solution cible réponde aux usages des équipes.
Votre responsabilité porte principalement sur le contenu fonctionnel, la coordination métier et la validation des évolutions.
Vos principales missions :
1. Porter les besoins métier

• Recueillir et analyser les besoins des utilisateurs de la GMAO.

• Animer les ateliers avec les équipes de maintenance et d’exploitation.

• Identifier les processus à conserver, à simplifier ou à faire évoluer lors de la transition.

• Formaliser les exigences, les user stories et les critères d’acceptation.

2. Structurer le backlog et les arbitrages

• Construire et maintenir le backlog produit.

• Proposer les priorités en fonction de la valeur métier, des contraintes opérationnelles et des dépendances.

• Challenger les demandes de reprise à l’identique et de développements spécifiques.

• Préparer et documenter les arbitrages avec les parties prenantes.

3. Coordonner la mise en œuvre

• Assurer l’interface entre les métiers, les équipes SI et le partenaire de configuration.

• Clarifier les besoins et suivre leur traduction dans la solution.

• Évaluer les conséquences fonctionnelles des choix proposés.

• Contribuer à l’identification des dépendances avec les données et les applications connectées.

4. Organiser la validation et accompagner la transition

• Définir les scénarios de recette à partir des usages métier.

• Coordonner la participation des utilisateurs à la recette et suivre les anomalies.

• Veiller à la couverture des besoins prioritaires avant le déploiement.

• Contribuer à la préparation des supports utilisateurs et à l’accompagnement du changement.

Expertise souhaitée
Profil recherché :
Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en tant que Product Owner, responsable fonctionnel ou Business Analyst senior sur des projets de GMAO, avec une pratique fonctionnelle de Maximo.
Compétences indispensables :

• Bonne maîtrise des processus de maintenance et de gestion des actifs : équipements, ordres de travail, maintenance préventive et corrective.

• Expérience fonctionnelle concrète de Maximo.

• Participation à une migration ou à une montée de version de Maximo.

• Connaissance de Maximo Application Suite, idéalement MAS 9.

• Participation à l’harmonisation de processus de maintenance entre plusieurs équipes ou sites.

• Capacité à recueillir, challenger et prioriser des besoins métier.

• Expérience de coordination entre utilisateurs, équipes SI et intégrateur.

• Maîtrise de la formalisation des exigences et de la recette fonctionnelle.

Qualités attendues :

• Écoute des utilisateurs et compréhension des réalités opérationnelles.

• Capacité à challenger les demandes et à expliciter les compromis.

• Rigueur dans la formalisation et le suivi des besoins.

• Aisance pour faciliter les échanges entre interlocuteurs métier et techniques.

• Capacité de synthèse et sens des priorités.

Non renseigné

title: Principal Product Manager - Catering & Events
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Catering & Events team owns one of Toast's most operationally important and fast-evolving products. Catering & Events helps restaurants take catering orders, manage private events, and get paid, all connected to the Toast platform. Operators use it for everything from daily office lunch orders to large weddings and buyouts, and it handles the details that make or break a high-stakes day.

Our vision is for Catering & Events to be the go-to solution for every Toast restaurant that caters or hosts events, and to serve a growing range of use cases across Toast's customer base. Getting there means three things: making the product easier to adopt and love, building the depth that sophisticated event operators expect, and applying AI to take work off operators' plates.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role at the intersection of restaurant operations, B2B software, and applied AI. You will shape how thousands of operators run their biggest revenue days, and you will help define where Catering & Events goes next.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

• Own and drive the Catering & Events product strategy, connecting investments to Toast's vision and near-term business outcomes such as revenue growth, customer retention, and support ticket reduction.

• Lead initiatives that help more customers get started and succeed with the product, from onboarding and setup to everyday workflows.

• Expand the product to serve more use cases and customer types across Toast's customer base, working directly with customers to translate complex, high-stakes workflow requirements into product decisions that serve the whole market.

• Define where AI creates real value for catering and event operators, and build the investment case to pursue the highest-leverage bets.

• Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success on packaging, positioning, and go-to-market to bring the product to the right customers in the right way.

• Shape and validate the business case for the next generation of Catering & Events, the long-horizon bets that drive future growth.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• Proven experience defining and owning product strategy for a complex, operationally critical product, with bonus points for experience in food and beverage, hospitality, events, or payments.

• Creative and strategic instincts. You identify the next meaningful bet, make the case for it, and drive it from zero to conviction.

• Curiosity and a point of view on AI and agentic product opportunities in operational environments. You do not need to have shipped an agent, but you should have a clear perspective on where autonomous action creates real value and where it creates real risk.

• A track record of working directly with customers, translating nuanced workflow requirements into product decisions that scale well beyond a single logo.

• Strong instincts for the SMB operator: you understand what it means to run a restaurant without a data analyst, an IT team, or a change management budget, and you can build for that reality.

• Executive presence to drive alignment without authority across Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, and product leadership in a high-stakes, cross-functional environment.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.
